entities.name: Newly Augmented Cinnamon Twig Decoction (Gui Zhi Xin Jia Tang)

formula_attributes.dosage: Cinnamon Twig (Gui Zhi) 9 g; Peony (Shao Yao) 12 g; Licorice (Zhi Gan Cao, roasted) 6 g; Fresh Ginger (Sheng Jiang, sliced) 12 g; Jujube (Da Zao, split) 12 pieces; Ginseng (Ren Shen) 9 g. Decoction method: with 1 dou 2 sheng of water, boil down to obtain 3 sheng, remove dregs, take 1 sheng warm.
formula_attributes.key_diagnostic_points: Gui Zhi Tang pattern with marked body pain, deficiency of stomach qi, and a deep slow pulse.
formula_attributes.contraindications: Do not use when there are signs such as reversal of cold (jue ni) or diarrhea; if interior collapse/rescue of the interior is required, treat the interior first.
